purpose: Determine whether any current-universe or pipeline-operational metadata can lawfully define a new three-session cross-sectional research factor without survivorship, identifier, or data-quality leakage.

schema_only_observation.interpretation: The file is a current universe snapshot for pipeline construction. Presence of a field does not grant historical point-in-time alpha use.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: current_snapshot_total_market_cap_rank
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The current universe market_cap field is not historically versioned for 2019-2023, and Campaign138 already closed market-cap/valuation reconstruction without an accepted point-in-time field.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: current_snapshot_float_market_cap_rank
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: float_market_cap is current-only in this snapshot; the separately admitted free-float and valuation branches are terminal and may not be recreated from current metadata.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: current_snapshot_st_or_security_name_state
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.filter: none; static current ST remains an eligibility exclusion only
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Current is_st/name fields cannot reconstruct historical state. ST is an eligibility exclusion, names are identity text, and the only frozen historical ST-recovery source branch is terminal.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: board_exchange_or_symbol_code_ordinal
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Board, exchange and symbol code define eligibility/identity. Any ordinal, hash, lexical rank or one-hot preference is arbitrary structural exposure rather than a close-known economic state for three-session ranking.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: current_snapshot_listing_date_or_membership_tenure
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: A current snapshot drops historical membership changes and creates survivorship. The accepted point-in-time listing-session youth factor was already tested in Campaign075 and terminated with zero development survivors.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: data_completeness_missingness_quarantine_or_provider_quality_rank
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.filter: accepted quality rules remain mandatory eligibility gates
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Missing rows, quarantines, file order, provider labels and validation outcomes describe data transport and eligibility. Ranking them would select measurement artifacts and conflict with the accepted source contract.

selection.reason: All six proposals are current-snapshot leakage, identifiers, eligibility states, terminal retries or data-quality artifacts; none is a lawful new economic information mechanism.
